notes.title: Patch Notes 5 - Higher Res Notes, 60+ FPS, Fixed Inverted Option
notes.content:
While hard at work with [i]CONCLUSE 2[/i], we wanted to address some of the last remaining issues players have reported in the past with [i]CONCLUSE[/i]. The biggest of those being the hard to read notes. We have redone all of the ones we felt had been the most reported and caused the most difficulty in game. Below you can see a before and after of the 'infamous' sewer puzzle note:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391998/2a32d10f4ecab2de4d67dc8348a583f19a4b4a9b.png[/img]

The other two changes in this patch are the addition of a 60 fps option (many of you already know that  by default the game is capped to 20), and a fix for the inverted controls option. We of course understand that not everyone wants to play the game with framerates experienced on the 20+ year old PS1, especially steamers who are also running recording software. The inverted controls fix removed the inverted x-axis, so that now only the y-axis is inverted.

The notes portion of this patch was also part of our mobile 1.3.9 update along with some scene specific tweaks.

Thank you for reading, we hope you're as excited as we are going forward with [i]CONCLUSE 2[/i]!

notes.title: Patch Notes 4 - Windowed Mode; Invert Mouse/Look X,Y; Resolution Options
notes.content:
Introducing the 'Options Patch', while these options likely should have been included with release, they're here now. We know that some of our players have a hard time seeing what's going on with the very low default resolution, and that other players resolutions are stretching to a 16:9 ratio regardless. Now there are 5 resolution options to choose, ranging from the default 472x319 up to 1920x1080. Along with this, there is a simple toggle to switch between fullscreen and windowed mode. The other option we decided to include in this patch is the ability to invert the mouse/right joystick. We hadn't previously thought of this option, but after it being brought up in the discussions we decided to include it. After all, we want as many people to be able to play and enjoy the game as possible.

Changelog
[list]
[*]Added OPTIONS menu to titlescreen.
[*]Invert look x,y axis option.
[*]Fullscreen/windowed option.
[*]Five resolution options.
[*]Ctrl-R hotkey added for resetting the resolution (in case of a resolution going off-screen and being unable to navigate to fix it).
[*]Other minor fixes.
[/list]

tags.feature: [*]Ctrl-R hotkey added for resetting the resolution (in case of a resolution going off-screen and being unable to navigate to fix it).

notes.title: Final Trailer Released - Count Down to Game Release
notes.content:
[h1]Final Trailer[/h1]
At long last the game's final trailer is here. After much hard work on the part of [i]Studio Snowspot[/i], we are proud to present the final trailer. Also, we have announced the winners of our early access soundtrack give away in the video description.
https://youtu.be/s0eQiMUZBIE
[h1]13 Days to Go[/h1]
We're getting close! [i]T Allen Studios[/i] is finishing coding and implementing some final 'polish features' like changing footstep sound effects when walking on different surfaces, and both [i]Studio Snowspot[/i] and [i]T Allen Studios[/i] are conducting tests and fixing any bugs that appear. We hope to have the game completely tested mid-week so we can start the Steamworks build process early, ensuring we get [b]CONCLUSE[/b] in your hands as planned the 29th.

[i]- T Allen Studios & Studio Snowspot[/i]

tags.feature: changing footstep sound effects when walking on different surfaces

tags.bug: fixing any bugs that appear

notes.title: Release Date Teaser
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/zhQrfUH1IcM
[h1]Release Date[/h1]
As you can now see on the Steam page and in the video above, we now have a public release date. On [b]June 29th[/b], Concluse will be available to download free, as will the official soundtrack. Though the soundtrack will be available on other platforms [b]June 21st[/b] for [i]$5.99[/i] as a way of supporting the artists who contributed to it, read the previous article for more information [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/826230/announcements/detail/1652138783570810796]Here[/url].
[h1]Final Trailer[/h1]
Due to the desire to make the final trailer really do the game and its fans justice, we will be leaving you with the release date trailer for now. Over the next couple of weeks Studio Snowspot will be preparing the final trailer, as T Allen Studios works on finishing hooking things up in the games later areas along with some final features.

As always thank you for checking in, and we hope you guys are as excited as we are! The game is almost in your hands!

- T Allen Studios & Studio Snowspot

notes.title: Preparing for Testing
notes.content:
[h1]Polishing and Visual Updates[/h1]
In the last development log, we shared with you the Sewers of Cordova. Since then a lot of work has gone into polishing all of the other pre-existing game areas, as well as adding a couple new ones.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391998/52f46e88a142f3d9b7ee487f2a4bd17031dfb6f9.png[/img]

Studio Snowspot has also introduced a couple other visual enhancements that increase immersion. Including rotatable 3d models of item pick ups, along with custom made notes that have replaced the plain text we used previously.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391998/9d1e6e6cbe9f08e8db78c1eeecd105da50a9472c.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391998/e4491bdb748bbfc652cba6cce119a413e5390176.png[/img]

[h1]Technical/Programming Update[/h1]
The most recent programming problems being worked on included tracking a multitude of things between scenes. Since players are able to go back and forth between areas as they please (presuming they have the necessary items), it was important to find a solution to keep things in each area as the player left them. We're happy to have this fully working at the time of this update.

We're now working on a save/load system that will allow multiple save slots, along with some other minor features. There are some other things that could be mentioned, but we can't spill everything can we? 

Thank you for reading and following our progress!

- T Allen Studios & Studio Snowspot

notes.title: A Journey Into the Darkness
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to our [b]first[/b] community announcement! 

For this first announcement we want to give you guys a glimpse into what we've been working on the most over the last week:

[h1]The Sewers of Cordova[/h1]

Currently featuring approximately 30 minutes of content, the sewers below Cordova have been expanded since the game's original release on the PlayStation. Find keys, solve puzzles, and most importantly: get out.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391998/15d64b3147131ce6ed5c9252f468094eb09a8c84.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391998/aaf2438caad2e0bc764d20aa56873891ab0a9042.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391998/dd43c5e4152b282c73907fed6dede278893f49b6.png[/img]

[h1]Controller Support[/h1]

Concluse will feature full Xbox 360 controller support on both it's PC and Mac releases. We are doing our best to integrate controllers in a way that feels natural and fits with common first person controller set ups.


Thank you guys for following the game, we hope that when it's done you love it as much as we do!

- T Allen Studios & Studio Snowspot
